lines: This is Sentry's console, Data Governance, recording Rosa's tap as it happens. Sped up.
Each node is an agent, a tool, or the model. Some tools belong to outside vendors, like the forecaster. Each arrow is one exchange: a request and its reply.
The count changes a little from run to run. In this one, Sentry counted 28 interactions for the tap, 8 of them calls to the model.
Open any exchange, and Sentry shows who called whom,
and exactly what was sent: here, her name and birth date, going to the patient lookup.
With the risk layer on, one exchange turns red: the report to the forecaster.
